name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou: Hai to Diamond
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 灰とダイヤモンド
source:
Looking into an inheritance dispute, [url=/c65]Jinguuji Saburou[/url] ends up investigating five seemingly unconnected cases and discovers a conspiracy. 

(Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jake_Hunter#Eighth-generation_consoles]Wikipedia[/url]])
translation:
在调查一桩遗产纠纷时，[url=/c65]神宫寺三郎[/url]最终查起了五起看似毫无关联的案件，并发现了一个阴谋。

（根据 [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jake_Hunter#Eighth-generation_consoles]维基百科[/url]内容编辑。）
